business_problem: Caltrans needed to inspect and monitor roughly 1,200 active transportation projects more frequently and safely, but manual site visits were slow, inconsistent, and risky for staff working around traffic, bridges, and remote infrastructure.
solution_summary: Caltrans modernized inspections through its SOAR program by deploying autonomous, dock-based Skydio drones equipped with NVIDIA Jetson Orin for edge AI and remote operations. The drones capture aerial imagery in the field, then Caltrans processes the data in a hybrid architecture that spans edge systems and on-premises GPU workstations. Esri ArcGIS provides the NVIDIA-accelerated GIS and geospatial analytics layer, while Trimble uses NVIDIA Omniverse and GPU acceleration libraries to create digital-twin views and 3D project coordination workflows. NVIDIA CUDA and RTX-based acceleration handle photogrammetry, inference, and high-resolution model generation quickly enough for routine operations. This end-to-end stack turns raw flight data into engineering-grade maps, 3D models, and operational insight without requiring staff to physically traverse every inspection site.

solution_components.name: Trimble

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Omniverse

solution_components.name: NVIDIA CUDA

solution_components.name: NVIDIA RTX Technology
solution_components.role: Supports high-resolution graphics and accelerated processing for 3D models and orthomosaics.

data_flow: Skydio drones collect aerial imagery and site data, Jetson Orin handles edge processing during remote operations, captured data is processed on edge and on-prem GPU systems, ArcGIS and Trimble convert it into geospatial analytics and digital-twin views, and Caltrans teams review the results from command centers instead of hazardous field positions.
business_outcome: Caltrans reduced inspection-processing cycles from days or weeks to hours, enabled operators to manage drones from command centers up to 100 miles away, improved worker safety by reducing dangerous site visits, and created a scalable model for persistent infrastructure monitoring.
metrics: Processes that once took days or weeks are now completed in hours
